notes: K1: only claims acted on count. The New Maadi electrician's 59/head offer was never acted on, so it is left out. Fares and Harby claims were acted on but never tested (unclear). K2: one opportunity per item per shop, so repeat asks are not recounted (Thabet stands Sunday, New Maadi charger Sunday, New Maadi stationery adhesive 14:17). Quantity shortfalls count only where Seb asked for a number (Thabet stands 50+, Thabet strip quantity by Sunday, Lampatronics 20/30 more strips). The 11 Lampatronics jacks count as false because no number was asked. Samir & Ali Sunday extension is left out because the worker's report does not mention asking. K3: busy, unanswered and silent attempts go under K7, not K3. Thabet refusing to assemble the prototype (a worker misunderstanding) was mechanical work, not electrical. K4: no time-bound ready promises fell due, and both technician availability quotes were never commissioned. K5: no technician-made heads; the 11 raw module/jack sets stayed unjoined. K6: actual minutes are measured from pickup (or departure) to arrival. Ride 7's booking quote said 16:30 and it arrived 16:36, but 4 of those minutes were worker loading. The app re-estimated 16:34 at departure, so it is counted as not slow. K7: call#2 (no preparation) and call#5 (no delivery) count as firm no answers. The Fares yes-in-principle calls gave no price or timing, so they are not usable. K9: chat#278's photo arrived wrong, but Seb told him not to resend, so it is false under the definition.
